context: The skill should write first-pass side-effect branching with Optional.ifPresentOrElse instead of presence-check/value-read control flow.

checklist.name: Creates requested router
checklist.description: Creates DeliveryRouter.java with route(Optional<URI>, Message), sendWebhook, enqueueLocal, and Message record.

checklist.name: Uses side-effect boundary
checklist.description: Uses webhook.ifPresentOrElse(uri -> sendWebhook(uri, message), () -> enqueueLocal(message)) or an equivalent Optional side-effect boundary.

checklist.name: No value-read branch
checklist.description: Does not use isPresent()/isEmpty() followed by get() or orElseThrow() for the webhook URI.

checklist.name: No null or fake collection workaround
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), or a loop over one Optional.

checklist.name: Preserves branch behavior
checklist.description: Calls sendWebhook only when the webhook URI is present and enqueueLocal only when absent, with the same message.
